description: Send a request to DataClue's sales team on the user's behalf: free evaluation samples, a paid pilot, a volume quote, or a custom collection. Side effect: emails the request (including the user's name, work email and company) to DataClue, who reply to that email. Only call this when the user has asked to contact DataClue and has provided their own work email, and show them the details to confirm before sending. Each call sends a new request, so do not retry a successful call.

company.description: The user's company (required except for samples).

datasets.description: Dataset slugs (from search_datasets). Required for pilot and volume.

details.description: Requirements in the user's words. Required for custom (what should be collected).

email.description: The user's work email. DataClue replies here.

name.description: The user's name (required except for samples).

plan.description: sample = free evaluation clips; pilot = 10-hour paid pilot; volume = quote for a number of hours; custom = data collected to order.

name: request_quote
title: Request samples or a quote
